description: Sign and post a delegation grant from the parent identity (sender) to a child pubkey. Verifiers confirm the message signature (proving the parent signed), that campfire_id matches the campfire the message is being read from (replay binding), and that expires_at has not passed.

args.name: child_pubkey
args.description: Hex-encoded ed25519 public key being granted authority

args.name: campfire_id
args.description: Hex-encoded campfire ID this grant is valid in — prevents cross-campfire replay

args.name: expires_at
args.description: Unix seconds; must be in the future and within 7 days of the message timestamp
